Chan DaNang is a VERY Underrated Restaurant in the Heart of My An District
May 2026 • Couples
This Restaurant is a Hidden Gem in Plain Sight. The Decor makes it comfortable for a Great Visual Dining Experience. The Staff is attentive and timely. And the food? Unusually Large Variety of Well prepared meals including Original Restaurant takes on some Classic Vietnamese Dishes. Delicious!!! My Vietnamese Wife and I truly love eating here. It has but one issue.... two doors down a neighboring Restaurant is Michelin Recommended. In Fact that is how we discovered Chan Nieu. We, like so many, ate many meals at the other aforementioned Restaurant. One night the line was so long we said let's take a walk. To our Surprise we saw Chan Nieu and thought what the heck. That began a Journey of Great Dining and Service. In fact, we have not been back to the other as, in my Rarely to be Humble Opinion, Chan Nieu has Better Food, Variety, Service and Value than Most. I rarely leave reviews anymore but these people deserve some accolades and recognition. I know that you will enjoy. BTW... if you usually order Morning Glory or another Vegetable with dinner may I suggest the Baby Pumpkins. Tasty and perfectly prepared. And tonight I tried a Special House Version of Bun Cha. Amazing. If you want a treat give Chan Nieu a try - You will not regret it. AND this review used Zero Ai and was written by Me!!!

Amazing meal!!! Fantastic!!!!
Jan 2026 • Couples
I had lunch here today and it was nothing short of incredible. The food was beautifully presented, bursting with authentic Vietnamese flavors, and easily the best meal I’ve had on this holiday so far. Every dish felt fresh and thoughtfully prepared, with the perfect balance of spice, texture, and taste.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with charming décor that makes you feel immersed in local culture. Service was outstanding — our server, Dat, spoke fantastic English and made the whole experience even smoother and more enjoyable. His attentiveness and friendliness really stood out.

If you’re in Đà Nẵng and want a memorable dining experience, Chạn Đà Nẵng is a must-visit. Top marks all around — I’ll definitely be coming back!
